description: mf4633/swmm-breach: v0.8.0 is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Michael Flynn (Hydrocomplete). swmm-breach v0.8.0 This release adds runnable EPA SWMM/PCSWMM example models, validates the .out reader against real engine output, and prepares the JWMM manuscript. Highlights Runnable example models in examples/: teton_pcswmm_example.inp (CMS/m) and anson_pcswmm_example.inp (CFS/ft), plus the generators that build them. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
